newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast late prod prices continue flat.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast late prod prices continue flat.

text.p: Late prices for U.S. West Coast refined products continued flat on Friday, as activity dried up ahead of the weekend.
Traders earlier said Thursday's steep decline in futures forced players to the sidelines on Friday.

The futures gave spot West Coast prices little momentum, with December heating oil easing 0.25 cent to 66.60 cents a gallon and front-month gasoline settling up a mere 0.09 cent to 64.70 cents a gallon.
Spot prices for CARB-grade conventional regular gasoline remained between 63.50 and 64.50 cents a gallon.
Premium CARB in L.A. hovered about four cents over regular CARB.
Spot prices for Los Angeles conventional unleaded gasoline stayed 60/61 cents a gallon. Premium gasoline stood five cents higher.
San Francisco conventional gasoline stayed one cent under L.A., at 59/60 cents.
